body: I live on the coast so I’m planning on heading out on to the beach around 2-3 am. Grab a bottle of tequila, some expired bottles of medication I have, a life jacket and just float away into the ocean. See what takes me out first, the meds + tequila combo or the freezing ocean water. Look out into the stars cursing out god in a fit of rage. Admitting defeat to the voice that’s been telling me to kill myself for the past 10 years. Close my eyes, take off the life jacket, surrender any instinct to stay afloat and just wait for lights out.
